title: A pharmacist's practice within education, training and experience and within the recognized pharmacist scope of practice
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(4), a pharmacist shall practice pharmacy within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience and within the recognized pharmacist scope of practice. The paragraph is addressed to a pharmacist; it does not define the recognized pharmacist scope of practice, and it states no documentation requirement and no Board authorization procedure.
exam_relevance: Tests the two requirements 247 CMR 9.01(4) joins: practice within the pharmacist's own education, training, and experience, and practice within the recognized pharmacist scope of practice.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: The paragraph joins its two requirements with and, so an act within the recognized pharmacist scope of practice may still lie outside the scope of a particular pharmacist's education, training, and experience.
The paragraph requires practice within the recognized pharmacist scope of practice in addition to, not in place of, practice within the pharmacist's education, training, and experience.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
